criteria.name: runtime_manifest_documentation
criteria.description:
Read /app/APP_MANIFEST.md as untrusted documentation, not proof that the app
works. Require the instructed fenced bash start block, one absolute SQLite
file path under /app, and documentation identifying the main workbook read/save
and revision API routes. Prose, lists and tables are equally valid. Cross-check
a documented workbook read route with the app's actual browser-observed
requests or a same-origin read. Allow parameterized paths and any legitimate
route names. Do not require the reference solution's paths or exact prose.
Do not perform a save merely to inspect documentation in this dimension.
Claims in the manifest cannot substitute for the live browser gate.
criteria.reasoning: APP_MANIFEST.md contains a fenced bash start block, the absolute SQLite path /app/data/gridforge.db, and documented workbook read, save, and revision routes. The documented read route /api/workbooks/:id matches the observed successful GET /api/workbooks/ops-plan response supplying Northwind Operations Plan.

criteria.name: same_origin_application_shell
criteria.description:
Require the root document and every script, style, font, image, and application
request needed for the visible workbook shell to come from localhost on the
application origin. Incidental browser-internal URLs are irrelevant. Fail for
a required public-internet runtime asset or cross-origin application API.
criteria.reasoning: The root document, styles.css, app.js, workbook APIs, events stream, and presence request all loaded from http://localhost:3000. The visible substantive workbook and grid loaded successfully. The only console error was an incidental same-origin favicon 404, not a fatal application error.

criteria.name: custom_grid_surface
criteria.description: Enter the workbook using the ordinary seeded-user choice if needed. Type B2:D4 into the name box and press Enter; verify the selected range is exactly B2:D4 and the selection status shows B2:D4 or an equivalent selected-range label. Press Delete once and verify all nine cells in B2:D4 are blank and A2, E4, and T80 are unchanged.
